headline: Circle Partners With DBS for Institutional USDC Services in Asia
summary: DBS will allow institutional clients to buy and redeem USDC directly as banks across Asia develop their own blockchain payment systems.
why: DBS is a major Singapore-based financial institution expanding its digital asset capabilities to meet institutional demand for stablecoins like USDC.

impacts.name: DBS Group Holdings
impacts.why: Integrating direct USDC purchase and redemption services expands institutional banking revenue opportunities.
